svg.desc: Web-display vector version of the selected beige academic teaser. Lettering is outlined as vector paths for stable typography. Conversations, RECONSIDER procedure, findings, and chart values are preserved. No raster images, external assets, or font files are embedded. For editable text, use the companion teaser_beige_editable.svg.

g.aria-label: CONVERSATIONMEMORYRESPONSIBLE AI

path.aria-label: Thoughtful AI for a kinder tomorrow.
When and How AI Companions Should Use Memory
Memory can sustain AI companionship, yet even accurate recollection can be inappropriate to use.

g.aria-label: An AI companion may remember a detailaccurately—but whether to bring it up dependson the current context.
I got an A on my exam!I’m so happy!
I remember how hard you’vebeen studying. You deserve this!
A timely, relevant memory can convey careand strengthen the relationship.
I’m feeling really anxioustoday...
Remember last time youfelt anxious before your exam?You said you failed that time...
Even accurate recollection can feel intrusive,stale, or unhelpful in the wrong context.

path.aria-label: Select and use only minimal, appropriate, and helpful memory for a better reply.

g.aria-label: Whose info is it, anddoes it still hold?
